maya: okay team tiny announcement: weve officially closed $5M ARR this quarter. absolute madness. thank you all :tada::party_popper:

jenn: on it. dropping a Google form for dietary restrictions in 10m
hr-bot: HR-Bot: Calendar invite created for "5M ARR Toast" — 2026-03-25 16:00 PT, Zoom link included for remote attendees
